event_detail: Stove knobs: a burner on the LEFT side of the stove (by the pot / kettle) is lit with a blue flame, and the gripper keeps working at the left-front knobs, while the front right burner stays off.
evidence: The copper-handled kettle sits on the back-left burner of the stove behind a steel pot, so stage 1 looks done. A blue flame is visible at the left-front of the stove beside the pot in every frame (wrist and left shoulder view), and the gripper stays low over the left-front corner near the left knobs; at 64.0 s the wrist camera is right at two front knobs below the pot. The right-hand burners show no flame in any frame. The lit burner appears to be a left one, not the front right one the stage asks for.
